paragraphs.source_en: A man, enveloped in a cloak, came out immediately, and exchanged some rapid words with the cardinal; after which he mounted his horse, and set off in the direction of Surgères, which was likewise the way to Paris.

paragraphs.source_en: “You have told me the truth, my gentlemen,” said he, addressing the Musketeers, “and it will not be my fault if our encounter this evening be not advantageous to you. In the meantime, follow me.”

paragraphs.source_en: The cardinal alighted; the three Musketeers did likewise. The cardinal threw the bridle of his horse to his esquire; the three Musketeers fastened the horses to the shutters.

The cardinal threw the bridle of his horse to his esquire; the three Musketeers fastened the horses to the shutters.

paragraphs.source_en: The host stood at the door. For him, the cardinal was only an officer coming to visit a lady.

paragraphs.source_en: “Have you any chamber on the ground floor where these gentlemen can wait near a good fire?” said the cardinal.

units.source_en: “Have you any chamber on the ground floor where these gentlemen can wait near a good fire?”

paragraphs.source_en: The host opened the door of a large room, in which an old stove had just been replaced by a large and excellent chimney.

paragraphs.source_en: “That will do,” replied the cardinal. “Enter, gentlemen, and be kind enough to wait for me; I shall not be more than half an hour.”

units.source_en: “Enter, gentlemen, and be kind enough to wait for me; I shall not be more than half an hour.”

paragraphs.source_en: And while the three Musketeers entered the ground floor room, the cardinal, without asking further information, ascended the staircase like a man who has no need of having his road pointed out to him.
